title: Typography: CSAIL Ebony
slide_intent: Introduce a type family through changes of voice. A reader can see which weights carry force in headlines and which feel more open across a line of text.
strategic_value: CSAIL can use a single family to express several qualities of research, from openness to confidence, while keeping a common typographic voice.
demonstration: A yellow specimen field juxtaposes very large bold and thin phrases with small italics and stacked words. The copy names the type designers and identifies Arial as a fallback.
practical_value: Choose a weight by the emphasis and length of the message, using the specimen to compare contrasting voices.

content_islands.name: Typeface description
content_islands.spec: Place the family’s origin, qualities and intended roles in a narrow left rail, with the fallback note in orange at the bottom.

content_islands.name: Expressive specimen
content_islands.spec: Fill the yellow panel with sample phrases in white and dark type. Use a dominant bold word, a long thin line, smaller italics and a stacked tagline at different scales.
